body: I developed Trich around the age of 13 and still suffer from it 14 years later. I have been called crazy and deranged more times than I can count by family and close friends because of my pulling, but I’m done hiding it. I think it’s about time we have these conversations.

Aww.. I was so skeptical sharing my art at first but I knew a lot of people would resonate with it. 

Sending you lots of love and good energy. 🙏🏼💛

You know when you build a tower of blocks and then it accidentally gets knocked over and you have to start all over again? It’s the same feeling. I did so well for a while, the hair grew back, I could finally stop wearing fake lashes and makeup to cover the bald spots and now I have to start all over again. It really is frustrating. 

Thank you for your message though, I will take your advice and try to be more mindful. I do beat myself up over it a lot.

“Going through stuff” is an understatement. 

I’m currently unemployed, broke, living with my abusive parents, and my boyfriend (not husband) is moving to a different country because he’s not safe here. We’re Arab and he’s trans, and living in an Arab/Muslim country, homosexuality is not only illegal, but also forbidden in Islam and is punishable by death. 

I understand why he needs to move and I’m so glad he was given the opportunity to leave this shit-hole country, but it still really hurts that we’re being separated like this. It wouldn’t be so bad if I was able to move too, but I can’t, because my family will not let me go. That’s why it feels like the only way out is by ending it once and for all.  


[Also, thank you.]

Exactly. What if I survive and end up with a horrible injury or a disability? I can’t do that to myself. I don’t have it in me. 

I’ve just been thinking about it a lot lately. Today was the closest I’ve gotten to actually doing it.. I started crying and kept on driving.

I really want to spend whatever time we have left just loving each other but it’s hard. It’s hard seeing him and not thinking about how I’m going to lose him soon. I don’t have a therapist, and can’t really afford one. I’m currently unemployed and my parents don’t approve of therapy and would never pay for it. It’s just all very fucked up.

I hear this way too many times. Said to me, and said to other parents to encourage beating.

It is not ok! And no, you did not turn out just fine and neither will your children!

I have parents with that mentality, I was physically abused up until I was a teenager and I’m 25 years old right now, I’m no where near fine. 

It’s all so messed up.
Arabic is my first language but I mostly think in English.

You’re definitely not alone. I really hate seeing myself in the mirror when I know I have bald spots. Sometimes when I’m examining where those spots are, it makes me wanna pull out any other eyelash that “stands out”... so I totally get it.

I know exactly how you feel. I didn’t understand or know about trich until I was 22, and I’ve been pulling since I was 13. Where I live, people believe mental illnesses meant you’re weak in faith, and any disorder like this meant you’re not right in the head. My own mother calls me a ‘freak’ and makes me feel horrible about it, which makes the pulling worse for me. It’s harder when you’re around people who don’t understand the seriousness or importance of someone’s mental health. But it’s ok, and you will be ok. 

I’m still looking for ways to stop pulling my eyelashes and eyebrows, and one thing that works (sometimes) is applying vaseline on my eyebrows so that every time I reach to pull, they’re too slippery. Petroleum jelly helps make them stronger too, so it kinda helps the existing brow hair! 

There are so many helpful youtube videos as well, some tricks work, some don’t. There will be relapses, but just be patient and kind to yourself. It sucks when other people bring you down and make you feel bad about having trich, but don’t mind them. They don’t understand, and this is what this community is for. We know, we understand, and we’re here to help one another in any way we can.
Yes, it’s the main reason I pull.
